stranger_1: ^I'm still tryin' to get used to the feel of this planet, you know?
stranger_2: ^Never thought I'd be feeling homesick this early on.
^It's hard to be told you can't go back.
stranger_3: ^Being a blacksmith is harder than I thought!
^University just taught me impractical stuff, it never taught me how to work with my hands.
stranger_4: ^How're you getting along with the town?
^There's quite a few faces I still haven't really met.
acquaintance_1: ^Raea's people are a lot more diverse in thought than I guessed. I thought they'd all be brainiacs like the ones on the Serenity.
^Although I guess there's also the Tranquility… they had some smarties too.
acquaintance_2: ^I think I'm finally getting the hand of blacksmithing. Although Wilhelm still doesn't let me do the hard stuff. Says I'd 'burn down his shop'.
^I'm not that much of a klutz, right?
acquaintance_3: ^You explored the forest at all yet?
^So weird checking out all the new and exotic plants combined with Earth's.
acquaintance_4: ^I still don't understand why Wilhelm has 3 furnaces.
^He can't work them all at once, I think he just likes to show off.
friend_1: ^I really need to buy some furnishings for my house, it just seems so hollow right now.
^It's so lifeless that I feel like I'm in my college dorm again!
friend_2: ^I wish I could just give Ben a big ol' hug.
^At least he sure seems like he could use one.
friend_3: ^I went into the mine a little while ago.
^Kinda wish I could go further, but it also seems kinda dangerous.
^Don't know why you do it... but hey, farming can't bring in too much money I guess.
friend_4: ^Seems like so long ago when we graduated from university.
goodfriend_1: ^I saw a couple of the kids running around town a little earlier.
^Reminded me of when we used to chase each other around the neighborhood.
goodfriend_2: ^Remember that time we studied abroad during university?
^Sorry, I just found my vlogs from back then and watched a couple.
^Maybe I'll show them to you sometime.
goodfriend_3: ^I might just head to the inn and chill for a bit.
^I wonder if that carpenter guy will be there today.
goodfriend_4: ^I really wanna see what's outside the dome.
^I'm just kinda itching to explore, y'know?
^Almost seems like we're imprisoned in here, but I know it's to keep the locals from ripping my face off.
bestfriend_1: ^I still haven't fully put my time on Earth behind me, but I'm finally starting to come to terms with it.
bestfriend_2: ^Maybe I should hang out with Miya or Jet later.
^Although I'd probably have to pick up some groceries from Ben before I do.
bestfriend_3: ^Although technically, aren't we the aliens in this case?
bestfriend_4: ^Sometimes I just go up on top of the abandoned mine and dream about what this town could look like in 50 years.
^It's a good way to get motivated and feel unstoppable, ya know?
